title: Part
spec: Create a new coordinate system with Euler angles set to zero and a translation vector also set to zero. On the first face, draw a two-dimensional sketch consisting of two loops. In the first loop, draw a rectangle using four lines: the first line starts at the origin (0.0, 0.0) and ends at (0.0112, 0.0); the second line starts at (0.0112, 0.0) and ends at (0.0112, 0.0112); the third line starts at (0.0112, 0.0112) and ends at (0.0, 0.0112); the fourth line starts at (0.0, 0.0112) and returns to the origin. Inside this rectangle, draw a second, smaller rectangle in the second loop using four lines: the first line starts at (0.0007, 0.0007) and ends at (0.0105, 0.0007); the second line starts at (0.0105, 0.0007) and ends at (0.0105, 0.0105); the third line starts at (0.0105, 0.0105) and ends at (0.0007, 0.0105); the fourth line starts at (0.0007, 0.0105) and returns to (0.0007, 0.0007). Apply a scaling factor of 0.0112 to the entire two-dimensional sketch. Transform the scaled sketch into three dimensions by rotating it with Euler angles set to zero and translating it with a vector also set to zero. Extrude the transformed sketch 0.75 units along the normal direction without extruding in the opposite direction. This process will create a new solid body with a length of 0.01125 units, a width of 0.01125 units, and a height of 0.75 units.

reference.label: Reference (dataset)
reference.code:
import cadquery as cq

# Create a new workplane
r = cq.Workplane("XY")

# Create the outer rectangle
r = r.box(0.0112, 0.0112, 0.75, centered=(False, False, False))

# Create the inner rectangle
inner_rectangle = cq.Workplane("XY").box(0.0105, 0.0105, 0.75, centered=(False, False, False)).translate((0.0007, 0.0007, 0))

# Cut the inner rectangle from the outer rectangle
r = r.cut(inner_rectangle)

# The final model is represented as 'r'

import cadquery as cq

# Create a new workplane
r = cq.Workplane("XY")

# Create the sketch
r = r.moveTo(0.0, 0.0) \
     .lineTo(0.0112, 0.0) \
     .lineTo(0.0112, 0.001) \
     .lineTo(0.001, 0.001) \
     .lineTo(0.001, 0.0112) \
     .lineTo(0.0, 0.0112) \
     .lineTo(0.0, 0.0) \
     .close()

# Extrude the sketch
r = r.extrude(0.75)

lanes.label: GLM-5.3 Flash (high)
lanes.code:
import cadquery as cq

# L-shaped angle profile extruded vertically (Z = 0.75)
L = 0.0112   # overall leg length
t = 0.0030   # wall thickness

profile = (
    cq.Workplane("XY")
    .moveTo(0, 0)
    .lineTo(L, 0)
    .lineTo(L, t)
    .lineTo(t, t)
    .lineTo(t, L)
    .lineTo(0, L)
    .close()
)

r = profile.extrude(0.75)

lanes.label: Kimi K3 (high)
lanes.code:
import cadquery as cq

# L-shaped angle bar with bounding box X 0.0112, Y 0.0112, Z 0.7500
# Top view shows an "L" cross-section

t = 0.005   # leg thickness
x = 0.0112  # overall X size
y = 0.0112  # overall Y size
z = 0.7500  # length along Z

# Sketch the L cross-section on the XY plane
r = cq.Workplane("XY") \
    .moveTo(0, 0) \
    .lineTo(x, 0) \
    .lineTo(x, t) \
    .lineTo(t, t) \
    .lineTo(t, y) \
    .lineTo(0, y) \
    .close() \
    .extrude(z)

# The final solid is assigned to 'r'
